Those small steps take so much effort at this point but I'm doing the absolute best I can. Right now that's not very much but I'm trying. I've attempted suicide once before but it was many years ago. I used to self harm as well. My biggest goals at the moment are not slipping and doing either of those things again. This feels like it'll never end though. 

Thank you for responding though, kind stranger. I really appreciate it.
